claims.statement: In N3(1/64), any literal physical cross block M with s3(A)>=1, S4(M)>(63/64)||M||F^2, s2(M)<1/64 and energy E>=1919/4160 yields another literal physical cross block M' with ||M'||F^2>1919/8192+(63/128)E>1919/4160, unless an earlier completed receiver pays the state.

A still-unpaid pure rank-one-tube chain must after finitely many source-coordinate descents produce P,Q,R with both A[P∪Q,P∪Q] and A[Q∪R,Q∪R] operator norm >63/64, ||A[P,Q]||F^2>961/4096, and ||A[P,R]||op^2>60351/266240; the current cross remains strong-top-four with s2<1/64.

At the fixed-floor low-disjointness cofactor state C=bD-cr^T with L>0.005239712846, |b|<1/32 and the double-star branch failed, either D-prime pays with density <851.946, there are >2/3 physical third-volume anchors on both orientations, or s1(C)^2/||C||F^2>511/512 and (s1(D)^2+s2(D)^2)/||D||F^2>127/128.

Pay the remaining E2 half-Riesz/double-star/nested-anchor/recursive-rank-two packets or the curvature-flip packet with one universal essential-density bound while preserving original-coordinate product structure, arbitrary same-bank curvature, all extra spectrum and all small nonzero coefficients.
